ayahs.arabicText: صٓ وَ الْقُرْاٰنِ ذِی الذِّكْرِؕ
ayahs.translation: Sad, and by the Qur'an full of exhortation!

ayahs.arabicText: بَلِ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا فِیْ عِزَّةٍ وَّ شِقَاقٍ
ayahs.translation: Nay, but the unbelievers are steeped in arrogance and stubborn defiance.

ayahs.arabicText: كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنْ قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوْا وَّ لَاتَ حِیْنَ مَنَاصٍ
ayahs.translation: How many a nation did We destroy before them! (When they approached their doom) they cried out (for deliverance), but the time for deliverance was already past.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ عَجِبُوْۤا اَنْ جَآءَهُمْ مُّنْذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ١٘ وَ قَالَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ هٰذَا سٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌۖۚ
ayahs.translation: They wondered that a warner had come to them from among themselves, and the deniers of the Truth said: “This is a sorcerer, and a big liar.

ayahs.arabicText: اَجَعَلَ الْاٰلِهَةَ اِلٰهًا وَّاحِدًا١ۖۚ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَیْءٌ عُجَابٌ
ayahs.translation: Has he made the gods one single God? This is truly astounding.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ انْطَلَقَ الْمَلَاُ مِنْهُمْ اَنِ امْشُوْا وَ اصْبِرُوْا عَلٰۤى اٰلِهَتِكُمْ١ۖۚ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَیْءٌ یُّرَادُۖۚ
ayahs.translation: And the elders among them went forth saying: “Go ahead and be steadfast in adhering to your deities. What is being said is with a design.”

ayahs.arabicText: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهٰذَا فِی الْمِلَّةِ الْاٰخِرَةِ١ۖۚ اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌۖۚ
ayahs.translation: We have not heard this in the religious community close to our time. This is nothing but a fabrication.

ayahs.arabicText: ءَاُنْزِلَ عَلَیْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِنْۢ بَیْنِنَا١ؕ بَلْ هُمْ فِیْ شَكٍّ مِّنْ ذِكْرِیْ١ۚ بَلْ لَّمَّا یَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابِؕ
ayahs.translation: Has this Exhortation been sent down among us only to him, to the exclusion of all others?” Nay, they are in doubt regarding My Exhortation, and are saying all this because they have not yet had any taste of My chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِیْزِ الْوَهَّابِۚ
ayahs.translation: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord, the Most Mighty, the Great Bestower?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ لَهُمْ مُّلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا١۫ فَلْیَرْتَقُوْا فِی الْاَسْبَابِ
ayahs.translation: Or do they possess the dominion of the heavens and the earth and of all that is in between them? If so, let them ascend the heights of the realm of causation and see!

ayahs.arabicText: جُنْدٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُوْمٌ مِّنَ الْاَحْزَابِ
ayahs.translation: This is only a small army out of the several armies that will suffer defeat here.

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ وَّ عَادٌ وَّ فِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْاَوْتَادِۙ
ayahs.translation: Before them the people of Noah, Ad, and Pharaoh of the tent-pegs gave the lie (to the Messengers)

ayahs.arabicText: وَ ثَمُوْدُ وَ قَوْمُ لُوْطٍ وَّ اَصْحٰبُ لْئَیْكَةِ١ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ الْاَحْزَابُ
ayahs.translation: and so did Thamud and the people of Lot and the people of Aykah. These were all leagued together.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ كُلٌّ اِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Each of them gave the lie to Messengers and My decree of chastisement came upon them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا یَنْظُرُ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ اِلَّا صَیْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِنْ فَوَاقٍ
ayahs.translation: They are waiting for nothing except a single Cry, after which there will be no second Cry.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا عَجِّلْ لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ یَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
ayahs.translation: They say: “Our Lord, hasten to us our share (of chastisement) before the Day of Reckoning.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِصْبِرْ عَلٰى مَا یَقُوْلُوْنَ وَ اذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوٗدَ ذَا الْاَیْدِ١ۚ اِنَّهٗۤ اَوَّابٌ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), bear with patience what they say, and call to mind Our servant David, who was endowed with great strength and who constantly turned (to Allah).

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهٗ یُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِیِّ وَ الْاِشْرَاقِۙ
ayahs.translation: With him We had subjected the mountains that they join him in celebrating Allah's glory, evening and morning,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الطَّیْرَ مَحْشُوْرَةً١ؕ كُلٌّ لَّهٗۤ اَوَّابٌ
ayahs.translation: and the birds, too, in their flocks, and turn again and again to celebrating Allah's glory.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ شَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهٗ وَ اٰتَیْنٰهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَ فَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ
ayahs.translation: And We strengthened his kingdom and endowed him with wisdom and decisive judgement.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هَلْ اَتٰىكَ نَبَؤُا الْخَصْمِ١ۘ اِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَۙ
ayahs.translation: Has the story of the litigants reached you -- of those who entered his private chambers by climbing over the wall?

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ دَخَلُوْا عَلٰى دَاوٗدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ١ۚ خَصْمٰنِ بَغٰى بَعْضُنَا عَلٰى بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُمْ بَیْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَ لَا تُشْطِطْ وَ اهْدِنَاۤ اِلٰى سَوَآءِ الصِّرَاطِ
ayahs.translation: As they came upon David -- and he was frightened of them -- they said: “Be not afraid. We are just two litigants: one of us has committed excess against the other. So judge rightly between us, and be not unjust; and guide us to the Right Way.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ هٰذَاۤ اَخِیْ١۫ لَهٗ تِسْعٌ وَّ تِسْعُوْنَ نَعْجَةً وَّلِیَ نَعْجَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌ١۫ فَقَالَ اَكْفِلْنِیْهَا وَ عَزَّنِیْ فِی الْخِطَابِ
ayahs.translation: Behold, this is my brother; he has ninety-nine ewes and I have only one ewe.” And yet he said: “Give her into my charge,” and he got the better of me in argument.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ اِلٰى نِعَاجِهٖ١ؕ وَ اِنَّ كَثِیْرًا مِّنَ الْخُلَطَآءِ لَیَبْغِیْ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ اِلَّا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ قَلِیْلٌ مَّا هُمْ١ؕ وَ ظَنَّ دَاوٗدُ اَنَّمَا فَتَنّٰهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهٗ وَ خَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَّ اَنَابَ۩ ۞
ayahs.translation: David said: “He has certainly wronged you in seeking to add your ewe to his ewes; and indeed many who live together commit excesses, one to the other, except those that believe and act righteously; and they are but few.” (While so saying) David realized that it is We Who have put him to test; therefore, he sought the forgiveness of his Lord, and fell down, bowing and penitently turning (to Him).

ayahs.arabicText: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهٗ ذٰلِكَ١ؕ وَ اِنَّ لَهٗ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفٰى وَ حُسْنَ مَاٰبٍ
ayahs.translation: Thereupon We forgave him his shortcoming and indeed (an exalted position of) nearness awaits him, and an excellent resort.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰدَاوٗدُ اِنَّا جَعَلْنٰكَ خَلِیْفَةً فِی الْاَرْضِ فَاحْكُمْ بَیْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَ لَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوٰى فَیُضِلَّكَ عَنْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ یَضِلُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِیْدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوْا یَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: (We said to him): “O David, We have appointed you vicegerent on earth. Therefore, rule among people with justice and do not follow (your) desire lest it should lead you astray from Allah's Path. Allah's severe chastisement awaits those who stray away from Allah's Path, for they had forgotten the Day of Reckoning.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَآءَ وَ الْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًا١ؕ ذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا١ۚ فَوَیْلٌ لِّلَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنَ النَّارِؕ
ayahs.translation: We did not create this heaven and earth and all that lies between them in vain. That is the fancy of those who denied the Truth. So woe from the Fire to all who deny the Truth.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِیْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِ١٘ اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِیْنَ كَالْفُجَّارِ
ayahs.translation: Shall We then treat alike those that believe and act righteously and those that create mischief on earth? Or treat alike the God-fearing and the wicked?

ayahs.arabicText: كِتٰبٌ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ اِلَیْكَ مُبٰرَكٌ لِّیَدَّبَّرُوْۤا اٰیٰتِهٖ وَ لِیَتَذَكَّرَ اُولُوا الْاَلْبَابِ
ayahs.translation: This is the Blessed Book that We have revealed to you, (O Muhammad), that people with understanding may reflect over its verses and those with understanding derive a lesson.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ وَهَبْنَا لِدَاوٗدَ سُلَیْمٰنَ١ؕ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ١ؕ اِنَّهٗۤ اَوَّابٌؕ
ayahs.translation: We bestowed upon David (an illustrious son), Solomon. How excellent a servant (of Ours he was)! Indeed he constantly turned to Us in devotion.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَیْهِ بِالْعَشِیِّ الصّٰفِنٰتُ الْجِیَادُۙ
ayahs.translation: And when one evening well-trained and running horses of noble breed were brought to him

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَالَ اِنِّیْۤ اَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَیْرِ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّیْ١ۚ حَتّٰى تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِٙ
ayahs.translation: he said: “Lo! I have come to love this wealth on account of the remembrance of my Lord.” And when the horses disappeared,

ayahs.arabicText: رُدُّوْهَا عَلَیَّ١ؕ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِالسُّوْقِ وَ الْاَعْنَاقِ
ayahs.translation: (he ordered): “Bring these horses back to me,” and then he began to gently stroke their shanks and necks.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَیْمٰنَ وَ اَلْقَیْنَا عَلٰى كُرْسِیِّهٖ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ اَنَابَ
ayahs.translation: Surely We put Solomon to the test and cast upon his throne a mere body. Thereupon he penitently turned (to Us).

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِیْ وَهَبْ لِیْ مُلْكًا لَّا یَنْۢبَغِیْ لِاَحَدٍ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِیْ١ۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
ayahs.translation: He said: “My Lord, forgive me and bestow upon me a kingdom such as none other after me will deserve. Surely You are the Bounteous Giver.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّیْحَ تَجْرِیْ بِاَمْرِهٖ رُخَآءً حَیْثُ اَصَابَۙ
ayahs.translation: We subjected the wind to him, so that it blew gently at his bidding, wherever he directed it,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الشَّیٰطِیْنَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَّ غَوَّاصٍۙ
ayahs.translation: and We also subjected the devils to him -- all kinds of builders and divers;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اٰخَرِیْنَ مُقَرَّنِیْنَ فِی الْاَصْفَادِ
ayahs.translation: and others that were bound with chains.

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ اَوْ اَمْسِكْ بِغَیْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.translation: “This is Our bestowal. So give or withhold as you wish without account.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ لَهٗ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفٰى وَ حُسْنَ مَاٰبٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Indeed an exalted position of nearness awaits him and an excellent resort.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَاۤ اَیُّوْبَ١ۘ اِذْ نَادٰى رَبَّهٗۤ اَنِّیْ مَسَّنِیَ الشَّیْطٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَّ عَذَابٍؕ
ayahs.translation: And remember Our servant Job: when he cried to his Lord: “Behold, Satan has afflicted me with much hardship and suffering.”

ayahs.arabicText: اُرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ١ۚ هٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَّ شَرَابٌ
ayahs.translation: (We commanded him): “Stamp your foot on earth, and here is cool water to wash with and to drink.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ وَهَبْنَا لَهٗۤ اَهْلَهٗ وَ مِثْلَهُمْ مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَ ذِكْرٰى لِاُولِی الْاَلْبَابِ
ayahs.translation: And We granted to him his family and also the like of them, as a mercy from Us, and as a reminder to people of understanding,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ خُذْ بِیَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِبْ بِّهٖ وَ لَا تَحْنَثْ١ؕ اِنَّا وَجَدْنٰهُ صَابِرًا١ؕ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ١ؕ اِنَّهٗۤ اَوَّابٌ
ayahs.translation: (and We said to him): “Take in your hand a bundle of rushes and strike with it, and do not break your oath.” Indeed We found him steadfast. How excellent a servant (of Ours) he was. Indeed he constantly turned (to his Lord).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اذْكُرْ عِبٰدَنَاۤ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ وَ اِسْحٰقَ وَ یَعْقُوْبَ اُولِی الْاَیْدِیْ وَ الْاَبْصَارِ
ayahs.translation: And remember Our servants -- Abraham, Isaac and Jacob -- they were endowed with great strength and vision.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّاۤ اَخْلَصْنٰهُمْ بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى الدَّارِۚ
ayahs.translation: Verily We exalted them in consideration of a sterling quality: their remembrance of the Abode of the Hereafter.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّهُمْ عِنْدَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَیْنَ الْاَخْیَارِؕ
ayahs.translation: In Our sight they are among the chosen and excellent ones.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اذْكُرْ اِسْمٰعِیْلَ وَ الْیَسَعَ وَ ذَا الْكِفْلِ١ؕ وَ كُلٌّ مِّنَ الْاَخْیَارِؕ
ayahs.translation: And remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhu al-Kifl. All were of the best.

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذَا ذِكْرٌ١ؕ وَ اِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِیْنَ لَحُسْنَ مَاٰبٍۙ
ayahs.translation: This was a remembrance. An excellent retreat awaits the God-fearing

ayahs.arabicText: جَنّٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ الْاَبْوَابُۚ
ayahs.translation: -- everlasting Gardens with gates wide open for them

ayahs.arabicText: مُتَّكِئِیْنَ فِیْهَا یَدْعُوْنَ فِیْهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِیْرَةٍ وَّ شَرَابٍ
ayahs.translation: wherein they shall recline, wherein they shall ask for abundant fruit and drinks,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ عِنْدَهُمْ قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرْفِ اَتْرَابٌ
ayahs.translation: and wherein there shall be with them well-matched, bashful mates.

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذَا مَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لِیَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
ayahs.translation: All this is what you are promised for the Day of Judgement.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ هٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهٗ مِنْ نَّفَادٍۚۖ
ayahs.translation: This is Our provision for you, never to end.

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذَا١ؕ وَ اِنَّ لِلطّٰغِیْنَ لَشَرَّ مَاٰبٍۙ
ayahs.translation: All this (is for the God-fearing). But for the transgressors, an evil resort awaits them --

ayahs.arabicText: جَهَنَّمَ١ۚ یَصْلَوْنَهَا١ۚ فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
ayahs.translation: Hell, where they will be roasted. An evil place to dwell!

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذَا١ۙ فَلْیَذُوْقُوْهُ حَمِیْمٌ وَّ غَسَّاقٌۙ
ayahs.translation: All this (is for them); so let them taste boiling water and pus,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اٰخَرُ مِنْ شَكْلِهٖۤ اَزْوَاجٌؕ
ayahs.translation: and other sufferings of the kind.

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ١ۚ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا النَّارِ
ayahs.translation: (Observing their followers advancing to Hell they will say, among themselves: “This is a troop rushing in to you. There is no welcome for them. They are destined to roast in the Fire.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا بَلْ اَنْتُمْ١۫ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ١ؕ اَنْتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوْهُ لَنَا١ۚ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ
ayahs.translation: They will reply: “Rather, no welcome to you. (You will roast in Hell.) It is you who led us to this end. What an evil resort!”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا مَنْ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِی النَّارِ
ayahs.translation: They will say: “Our Lord, give twofold punishment in the Fire to him who has led us to this.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرٰى رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُمْ مِّنَ الْاَشْرَارِؕ
ayahs.translation: They will say to one another: “But why do we not see those whom we considered him among the wicked?

ayahs.arabicText: اَتَّخَذْنٰهُمْ سِخْرِیًّا اَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْاَبْصَارُ
ayahs.translation: Is it that we mistakenly made fun of them; or have they disappeared from our sight?”

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ اَهْلِ النَّارِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Verily all this is true. This is how the inmates of the Fire will dispute among themselves.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا مُنْذِرٌ١ۖۗ وَّ مَا مِنْ اِلٰهٍ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُۚ
ayahs.translation: Tell them, (O Prophet): “I am nothing but a warner. There is no deity but Allah, the One, the Supreme,

ayahs.arabicText: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا الْعَزِیْزُ الْغَفَّارُ
ayahs.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them, the Most Mighty, the Most Forgiving.”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا عَظِیْمٌۙ
ayahs.translation: Say: “This is a tiding of tremendous import

ayahs.arabicText: اَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: from which you are turning away.”

ayahs.arabicText: مَا كَانَ لِیَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِالْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰۤى اِذْ یَخْتَصِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (Tell them): “I had no knowledge of the High Council when they were disputing.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ یُّوْحٰۤى اِلَیَّ اِلَّاۤ اَنَّمَاۤ اَنَا نَذِیْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: I am told (about matters) by means of revelation only because I am a clear warner.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اِنِّیْ خَالِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّنْ طِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: When your Lord said to the angels: “Verily I am creating a human being from clay.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِذَا سَوَّیْتُهٗ وَ نَفَخْتُ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِیْ فَقَعُوْا لَهٗ سٰجِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: After I have created him and breathed into him of My spirit, fall you down, prostrating yourselves to him.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ اَجْمَعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Then the angels, all of them, prostrated themselves before Adam

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّاۤ اِبْلِیْسَ١ؕ اِسْتَكْبَرَ وَ كَانَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: except Iblis. He waxed proud and became one of the unbelievers.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰۤاِبْلِیْسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِیَدَیَّ١ؕ اَسْتَكْبَرْتَ اَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْعَالِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Lord said: “O Iblis, what prevented you from prostrating yourself before him whom I created of My Two Hands. Are you waxing proud, or fancy yourself to be too exalted?”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اَنَا خَیْرٌ مِّنْهُ١ؕ خَلَقْتَنِیْ مِنْ نَّارٍ وَّ خَلَقْتَهٗ مِنْ طِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: He replied: “I am nobler than he. You created me from fire and created him from clay.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِیْمٌۚۖ
ayahs.translation: He said: “Get out of here; surely you are accursed,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اِنَّ عَلَیْكَ لَعْنَتِیْۤ اِلٰى یَوْمِ الدِّیْنِ
ayahs.translation: and My curse shall remain upon you till the Day of Resurrection.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنْظِرْنِیْۤ اِلٰى یَوْمِ یُبْعَثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Satan said: “My Lord, then grant me respite till the Day that they are raised up.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: He said: “You are of those who have been granted respite

ayahs.arabicText: اِلٰى یَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُوْمِ
ayahs.translation: till the Day whose Hour I know.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَاُغْوِیَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: (Iblis) said: “By Your glory, I shall mislead them all

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: except those of Your servants, the chosen ones from amongst them.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَالْحَقُّ١٘ وَ الْحَقَّ اَقُوْلُۚ
ayahs.translation: He (i.e. Allah) said: “This is the Truth -- and I only speak the Truth --

ayahs.arabicText: لَاَمْلَئَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكَ وَ مِمَّنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ اَجْمَعِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: I will certainly fill the Gehenna with you and with all those among them who follow you.”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ مَاۤ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَیْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ وَّ مَاۤ اَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), tell them: “I do not ask you for any recompense for the performance of this task; nor am I given to affectation.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: This is nothing but an Admonition for all people the world over.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَاَهٗ بَعْدَ حِیْنٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: You will know the truth of the matter after a while.”
